name: Educational CI/CD Pipeline (Учебная работа №2)

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, master ]
    tags: [ 'v*' ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, master ]
  workflow_dispatch:  # Ручной запуск

jobs:
  # ========== ЭТАП 1: СБОРКА ==========
  build:
    name: 1. Сборка программы
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential g++ make

      - name: Build program
        run: make

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ferma-test-binary
          path: ferma-test
          retention-days: 1

  # ========== ЭТАП 2: ТЕСТИРОВАНИЕ ==========
  test:
    name: 2. Запуск unit-тестов
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download binary
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ferma-test-binary
          path: .

      - name: Make executable
        run: chmod +x ferma-test

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: |
          echo "=== Запуск тестов ==="
          # Тест 1: Простое число
          echo "Тест 1: Число 7 (простое)"
          ./ferma-test 7 && echo "✓ ТЕСТ ПРОЙДЕН" || echo "✗ ТЕСТ НЕ ПРОЙДЕН"
          
          echo ""
          echo "Тест 2: Число 10 (составное)"
          ./ferma-test 10 && echo "✗ ТЕСТ НЕ ПРОЙДЕН" || echo "✓ ТЕСТ ПРОЙДЕН"
          
          echo ""
          echo "=== Все тесты завершены ==="

      - name: Save test results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: test-results
          path: test-results/
          retention-days: 7
        if: always()

  # ========== ЭТАП 3: УПАКОВКА В DEB ==========
  package:
    name: 3. Упаковка в .deb пакет
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download binary
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ferma-test-binary
          path: .

      - name: Install packaging tools
        run: sudo apt-get install -y dpkg-dev

      - name: Build .deb package
        run: |
          VERSION=${GITHUB_REF_NAME:-1.0.0}
          VERSION=${VERSION#v}
          
          # Создаём структуру пакета
          mkdir -p debian/ferma-test/usr/local/bin
          mkdir -p debian/ferma-test/DEBIAN
          
          # Копируем бинарник
          cp ferma-test debian/ferma-test/usr/local/bin/
          chmod 755 debian/ferma-test/usr/local/bin/ferma-test
          
          # Создаём control файл
          cat > debian/ferma-test/DEBIAN/control << EOF
          Package: ferma-test
          Version: ${VERSION}
          Section: math
          Priority: optional
          Architecture: amd64
          Maintainer: ${{ github.actor }} <${{ github.actor }}@users.noreply.github.com>
          Description: Ferma prime test program
           A program for testing prime numbers using Fermat's theorem.
           This package was built automatically by GitHub Actions CI/CD.
          EOF
          
          # Собираем пакет
          dpkg-deb --build debian/ferma-test
          mv debian/ferma-test.deb ferma-test_${VERSION}_amd64.deb
          
          echo "Пакет создан: ferma-test_${VERSION}_amd64.deb"

      - name: Upload .deb package
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: deb-package
          path: ferma-test_*.deb
          retention-days: 14

  # ========== ЭТАП 4: СОЗДАНИЕ РЕЛИЗА ==========
  release:
    name: 4. Создание релизной версии
    needs: package
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Download .deb package
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: deb-package
          path: release/

      - name: Create GitHub Release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v1
        with:
          files: release/ferma-test_*.deb
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
          generate_release_notes: true
          name: "Релиз ${{ github.ref_name }}"
          body: |
            ## Релиз программы Ferma Prime Test
            
            ### Что включает этот релиз:
            - ✅ Собранный бинарный файл `ferma-test`
            - 📦 DEB пакет для установки на Ubuntu/Debian
            
            ### Установка:
            ```bash
            sudo dpkg -i ferma-test_*.deb
